free_tier.stated: no free tier on this plan: Max is USD 180 a month on the annual plan and includes USD 200 of agent usage each month at API rates; usage beyond that is bought as add-on usage
free_tier.notes: included usage resets monthly even on an annual plan and does not roll over; the price for monthly (non-annual) billing is unverified: not on the pricing card read

interface_detail: the Warp Agent CLI (the `warp` binary) is an interactive terminal program; its documented flags are --api-key, --auto-approve, --resume, --set-provider-api-key, --clear-provider-api-key, --help and --version, and none is a prompt-and-exit flag, so a headless prompt mode of `warp` itself is unverified. Headless use is documented two ways: `warp` authenticates with the WARP_API_KEY environment variable on CI runners and remote servers, and the legacy Oz CLI runs a one-shot agent with `oz agent run --prompt "..."` (local) or `oz agent run-cloud` (cloud), authenticated by the same API key
tooling: the user installs the Warp Agent CLI with `curl -fsSL https://app.warp.dev/download/agent-cli | bash` (macOS and Linux; Windows and Homebrew installers also exist) or uses the Warp desktop app; the agent is Warp-hosted, and requests route through Warp's servers to the chosen model provider
chaining: usage is metered in dollars at API rates, so dollars of included usage buy tokens at each model's list price; a user key or custom endpoint bypasses the allowance and the provider bills it

limits.value: USD 200 of agent usage included each month at API rates; resets monthly, no rollover; further usage is bought as add-on usage, optionally with auto-reload under a team spend limit (default USD 200 a month)

limits_note: the included allowance is USD 200 of agent usage a month at API rates; add-on usage is bought beyond it
binding_note: the monthly included allowance is USD 200 of agent usage; past it, usage is bought as add-on usage

identity_cost.detail: a Warp account plus payment details at subscription (the upgrade flow takes payment details and emails an invoice); whether a phone number is asked at sign-up is unverified: behind a…

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; Warp-managed model traffic is covered by zero-data-retention agreements with the underlying providers
confidence_note: plan price, included usage, add-on controls and the Warp Agent CLI's authentication are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02; the monthly-billing price and the per-model rates that turn dollars of usage into tokens were not read.
